prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
ai_overview_text:
Finding the "best" dentist for a dental implant in Phoenix depends on whether you need a single tooth replaced or a full-arch (All-on-4) restoration. Several top-rated local practices and specialists consistently receive high patient ratings and specialized recognition:
Lead Doctor: Dr. Joe Mehranfar
Rating: 4.9/5 (579+ reviews)
Focus: Locally owned and specializes exclusively in dental implants, ranging from single teeth to full-mouth Zirconia All-on-4® cases with an in-house digital lab.
Specialist vs. General Dentist: For complex cases, bone grafts, or sinus lifts, a periodontist or oral surgeon has specialized surgical training. For straightforward single-tooth implants, a restorative general dentist with dedicated implant experience works well. Phoenix Implant Clinic +2
All-Inclusive Pricing: Ask whether the quote covers the implant post, the abutment, and the crown separately, or if it is a bundled flat fee. Dental Hearts +1
Get a Second Opinion: Many implant centers (like Nuvia or Aria) offer complimentary or low-cost initial 3D CT scans and consultations, making it easy to compare treatment and cost plans. Yelp +3
If you can share whether you need a single tooth replacement or a full-arch / All-on-4 solution—as well as your insurance status or budget—I can narrow down the best specific recommendation for you.
